source_name: Bisnode / Dun & Bradstreet GVIN (gvin.com) - SI business intelligence incl. public contracts
why_relevant: Commercial SI business-intelligence platform that explicitly bundles public contracts and procurement plus public tenders alongside company financials, ownership, management and press coverage. Uniquely lets us join an SI bank's or vendor's procurement footprint to its corporate and financial profile - the highest-value paid source in this cell.

source_name: eBonitete.si - SI credit-rating and company data portal
why_relevant: Commercial SI company-data portal in the Bonitete family. Not a tender aggregator per se, but resolves supplier identities (matična/davčna številka) behind award notices, which is what turns an aggregator record into a usable actor entry.

source_name: OPSI - Odprti podatki Slovenije: procurement datasets (contracts, active tenders, business entities)
why_relevant: The national open-data catalogue holds machine-readable SI procurement archives: the ERAR procurement collection (sourced from enarocanje.si), 'Pregled objavljenih pogodb po oddaji javnega naročila' (published post-award contracts), the active-tenders list from the e-JN information system, and the ERAR business-entity register. This is the cheapest, most legally clean bulk archive for SI procurement.

source_name: Open Contracting Partnership Data Registry - TED/OpenTender publication entry
why_relevant: Registry entry documenting the TED/OpenTender publication, its format, coverage and quality caveats. A meta-source for judging whether an aggregator's SI coverage is complete, and a route to other OCDS publishers that may cover SI.

source_name: fabiodisconzi.com open-TED - CPV/country notice indexes for Slovenia
why_relevant: Independent static mirror/archive of TED notices indexed by year, CPV and country - a ready-made SI-by-CPV browse path (the example is CPV 72312100 data-preparation services). Useful for rapid CPV-scoped reconnaissance and as a fallback when TED's own UI is awkward; freshness and completeness unverified.

source_name: Apify 'EU TED Tenders' scraper actor
why_relevant: Off-the-shelf collector for TED notices filterable by country/CPV/date/value/notice type with JSON output. A ready-made ingestion path for the SI slice of TED without building a parser; also a POINTER to the field schema other resellers normalise to.

source_name: Finance.si (Časnik Finance) — business daily, banking & IT procurement coverage
why_relevant: Slovenia's only business daily; routinely reports which vendor won a bank/state financial-sector contract, contract values, and disputes. Covers private-bank vendor switches that no public register records.

source_name: Delo — Gospodarstvo/Finance section
why_relevant: Leading national daily; covers contested tenders, cancelled procurements and state-owned bank (NLB, SID) vendor decisions. Archive at old.delo.si carries older procurement stories (e.g. Banka Slovenije banknote-processing procurement).

source_name: Svet kapitala (Delo) — capital markets & finance magazine
why_relevant: Delo's dedicated finance/capital vertical; longer-form pieces on bank strategy, fintech vendors and digitalisation projects — useful for private-sector contract signals absent from registers.

source_name: Dnevnik.si — Poslovni dnevnik / Slovenija
why_relevant: National daily with investigative record on disputed public procurement, DKOM appeals and state-sector IT contracts.

source_name: Večer — Gospodarstvo (Maribor-based daily)
why_relevant: Strong NE-Slovenia coverage (Nova KBM/OTP heritage, Maribor institutions); named among outlets reporting on DKOM matters, so a genuine carrier of tender-dispute detail.

source_name: STA — Slovenska tiskovna agencija (Slovenian Press Agency)
why_relevant: Wire service; first and often only report of contract signings, tender cancellations and DKOM rulings. Its items are syndicated across Slovene media, so STA text is the upstream of most coverage.

source_name: Državna revizijska komisija (DKOM) — 'Medijske objave o DKOM' media-clippings page
why_relevant: The regulator itself curates a list of media articles about procurement disputes it has ruled on — an efficient pointer from press coverage back to the underlying tender and vice versa.

source_name: Monitor — Slovene IT monthly
why_relevant: Technical trade press covering ATM/self-service hardware, core banking and card systems; publishes vendor-level detail (who supplies what) that general press omits. Confirmed ATM-technology feature.

source_name: Računalniške novice — IT trade biweekly + vendor-partner directory
source_subtype: IT trade press / vendor PR channel
why_relevant: Publishes vendor press releases about signed contracts (e.g. first contract for a named e-service) and maintains partner profiles including Bankart (the Slovene card-processing utility) — doubles as an actor-map pointer.

source_name: Racunovodja.com — accounting/legal professional publication
why_relevant: Publishes plain-language explainers of procurement regulation (e.g. Uredba o finančnih zavarovanjih pri javnem naročanju) — supplies the legal vocabulary and rule changes needed to interpret award notices.

source_name: JNP d.o.o. — portal za javna naročila (procurement consultancy portal)
why_relevant: Commercial procurement-advisory portal indexing misdemeanour decisions and Q&A on bidder/contracting-authority conduct; a bridge between press coverage and case law, and a map of the practitioner community.

source_name: Odvetnik Marovt — procurement law firm blog ('Kaj je v ponudbi javno?')
why_relevant: Specialist procurement lawyer explains exactly which bid data (unit prices, total contract value) are public after award — directly governs what a collector can lawfully expect to obtain from Slovene tender files.

source_name: Informacijski pooblaščenec (IPRS) — ZDIJZ FAQ and opinions
why_relevant: Defines the FOI route Slovene journalists use to obtain bank/state contract values, including special ZDIJZ duties for banks that received stability measures — the mechanism behind the media disclosures this cell tracks.

source_name: Komisija za preprečevanje korupcije (KPK) — procurement corruption-risk analyses
why_relevant: Publishes analyses of corruption risk in procurement that name recurring patterns and sectors; its Erar/Supervizor spending transparency work is the standard cross-check journalists use on contract claims.

source_name: Žurnal24 — popular daily (banking IT incident reporting)
why_relevant: Covers customer-visible failures of bank core-system migrations (e.g. BKS Bank information-system problems) — such incidents reveal which vendor/system a private bank actually switched to.

source_name: Slo-Tech — Slovene IT community forum
why_relevant: Practitioner forum where bank IT migrations and card-issuing problems (e.g. Nova KBM/Abanka card merger issues) are discussed with technical specificity and timing well ahead of press coverage.

source_name: Združenje bank Slovenije (ZBS) — Bančni vestnik and ABC bančnih izrazov
why_relevant: Banking association: its glossary supplies the authoritative Slovene banking vocabulary for query building, and Bančni vestnik articles name systems/vendors and sector projects; also maps member banks (the buyer universe).
